parse_webhook_payload: parse a HuggingFace webhook JSON payload into a WebhookPayload Pydantic model
validate_webhook_event: validate a webhook event action against the supported WebhookEvent_T literal types
parse_webhook_repo: parse a webhook repository payload into a WebhookPayloadRepo model with owner and URL fields
parse_webhook_discussion: parse a webhook discussion payload into a WebhookPayloadDiscussion model with status and changes
parse_webhook_comment: parse a webhook comment payload into a WebhookPayloadComment model with author and URL
